$comment: Looks written only on public surfaces (docs/cmux-next/look-addons.md), and the twin of every look cmux builds in. Each `addon` is a setup folder here that installs with `cmux setup install` and from the community registry. `builtIn` names the built-in preset a look recreates: the setting that selects it and the agent-pane.transcript gallery variant that draws it. webviews test/browser/look-addons.test.ts draws the add-on through the host's own customization path and compares it with that variant; scripts/check-look-addons.ts fails when a built-in look id has no entry here, so no built-in look can depend on code an outsider cannot reach. `pending` says why an entry has no add-on twin yet.

looks.pending: The built-in Studio transcript preset (agentPane.display.transcriptLook studio) is in review in #46047 and #46258; once it lands this entry names it and its gallery variant. Until then the add-on is the reference it must match.

The composer look is page storage only (composerLook.ts); a setup cannot select it until a setting carries it (#43272, #45843), and the composer has no paint tokens yet.
As claude: the default composer look, page storage only until #43272 or #45843 lands.

The ChatGPT replica's round composer, opt-in only: the in-box composer (agentPane.composerLook studio) and a circular + highlight (--cv-composer-icon-radius). cmux's own composers keep the app's corner; there is no built-in twin.

An opt-in behavior preset, not a stylesheet look: it sets one setting and no agent-pane/theme.css. The pop is cmux#50293; the switch it needs, agentPane.display.sendPop (off by default, pop), is not in any build yet, so the setup carries it as a comment.

An opt-in behavior preset, not a stylesheet look: no entrance on send and the sent prompt placed near the top with room for the reply. Its placement switch, agentPane.sendPlacement (bottom by default, top), does not exist yet; agentPane.display.sendPop off arrives with cmux#50293.
